content: Tauri v2 IPC: default channel JSON-serializes; raw request/Channel API needed for large payloads (~5ms/10MB macOS but 200ms Windows). WKWebView memory grows with large DOM; keep docs virtualized. macOS signing: Developer ID cert + hardened runtime (codesign -o runtime) + notarize + staple; sidecar/externalBin binaries each need signing (tauri#11992); updater minisign signature independent of notarization.
